name: Tiszaug (Hungary)
description: Medium blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tiszaug: a quartered shield of green, red and white with fish, a fleur-de-lis and a river, within a wreath of oak leaves.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
